invariants.statement: Derived context never silently replaces primary evidence.
Canonical integrity does not itself establish scientific truth.
Ranking, majority, reward, or popularity cannot promote a claim to truth by themselves.
Missing, unknown, or abstained evidence cannot be silently converted to success, failure, or zero.
Persistent mutation requires content-addressed provenance and evidence.
A generator cannot be its sole promotion authority.
An experiment cannot mutate its verifier or evaluator contract after execution starts.
Normal architecture or policy evolution cannot modify K0 semantics.
Normal policy evolution cannot self-modify executable code.
Secrets, privacy, permissions, and authority boundaries fail closed.
Historical lineage and evidence are not rewritten; later claims may supersede, narrow, contradict, or retract them.
Canonical promotion requires a defined recovery or rollback path.
